units.source_text: 春季举行官吏任免式时，皇后名下的人员都不曾受到应得的官职。

en.t: At the spring ceremony for appointing and dismissing officials, none of the people attached to the Empress received the offices they deserved.

units.source_text: 照一般情理或皇后地位说来都是应有的升官晋爵，今年也全然没有。

en.t: Promotions and honors that should have been granted, whether by ordinary custom or by the Empress's rank, were entirely absent this year as well.

units.source_text: 因此有许多人悲愤愁叹。

en.t: Because of this, many people grieved, felt indignant, and lamented bitterly.

units.source_text: 皇后虽已出家为尼，并无立即让位停俸之理。

en.t: Although the Empress had already taken vows and become a nun, there was no reason she should immediately give up her position and stipend.

units.source_text: 然而此次朝廷竟以出家为由，对这皇后的待遇大有变更。

en.t: Yet this time the court used her religious vows as a pretext and made sweeping changes to the treatment accorded to the Empress.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后自身对此世间固已毫无留恋，

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo herself had, to be sure, no lingering attachment to this world,

units.source_text: 然而众宫人都失去依靠，大家悲叹命苦。

en.t: but the many court ladies had lost their support, and all of them mourned their hard fate.

units.source_text: 皇后睹此情状，有时亦不免愤慨。

en.t: When the Empress saw this state of affairs, she too could not help feeling indignant at times.

units.source_text: 她自身已置之度外，但切望皇太子平安无事地即位，

en.t: She had already set aside all concern for herself, but she earnestly wished that the Crown Prince would ascend the throne safely and without incident,

units.source_text: 因此矢志不懈地勤修佛道。

en.t: and therefore devoted herself unwaveringly and diligently to Buddhist practice.

units.source_text: 只因这皇太子身上有不可告人而深可危惧的隐情，

en.t: Because there was a hidden matter concerning the Crown Prince that could not be told to anyone and was deeply alarming,
she often prayed to the Buddha:

units.source_text: “一切罪恶皆归于我，务请容恕太子无辜。”

en.t: "Let all sin fall upon me; please forgive the innocent Prince."
Amid every kind of worry and anguish, she consoled herself in this way.

units.source_text: 源氏大将也体会藤壶皇后的衷曲，

en.t: General Genji also understood the hidden anguish in Empress Fujitsubo's heart,
and thought that it was truly a painful and devoted concern.

units.source_text: 他自己殿内的人员，与皇后宫中的人一样，也都轲不遇。

en.t: The people in his own residence, like those in the Empress's palace, were all neglected and unlucky as well.

units.source_text: 他觉得这世间毫无意味，

en.t: He felt that this world held no meaning at all,
and shut himself away at home day after day.
